narrative.intro: Black Construction Tutor Perini obligated $710M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Black Construction Tutor Perini received 14 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $50.7M and obligations up 448.3% year over year. Black Construction Tutor Perini concentrated its work in Commercial and Institutional Building Construction, which totaled $703M in obligations, and in New Multifamily Housing Construction (except For-Sale Builders), which totaled $7.2M. Black Construction Tutor Perini obligations by fiscal year show the firm moved from $98.5M in FY21 to $286M in FY22, then $71.2M in FY23, $228M in FY24, $129M in FY25, and $710M in FY26. Black Construction Tutor Perini current-year totals are partial, representing fiscal year to date obligations, and the listed award counts and averages reflect that partial year.

sections.heading: Where does Black Construction Tutor Perini win its government work?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the largest NAICS market for Black Construction Tutor Perini with $703M in obligations. New Multifamily Housing Construction (except For-Sale Builders) is a smaller market for Black Construction Tutor Perini with $7.2M in obligations. Fiscal-year trends show Black Construction Tutor Perini obligations rose to $710M in FY26 after $129M in FY25 and $228M in FY24.
